name: WHRNXT
description: WHRNXT will show you where the nearest sight is to you now or sorted by distance in your language. Click the sight for a button that allows you to get directions or book a rideshare easily. Planning a trip? The app has 2,900+ cities  and 73,000+ places to see. These trips can be optimized for the shortest total walking or driving route, and shared with others. The app is free, your plans are saved on your phone, private & offline, no login or account needed.
